name: Unsloth Hermes-4-405B (GGUF quant set)
license: Llama-3 Community License (quant repo: llama3 tag)
notes: Same weights as NousResearch/Hermes-4-405B - config.json matches - but shipped as the only practical single-node artefact. Sums of per-file sizes measured from the repo tree on the access date: BF16 811.75 GB across 17 shards, Q8_0 431.24 GB across 9 shards, UD-Q5_K_XL 286.50 GB across 6 shards, Q4_K_M 243.07 GB across 5 shards, UD-Q4_K_XL 243.72 GB across 5 shards, UD-Q3_K_XL 197.39 GB across 4 shards, UD-Q2_K_XL 151.36 GB across 4 shards, UD-IQ1_M 94.73 GB across 2 shards, UD-IQ1_S 87.22 GB across 2 shards. These are sharded repos: each directory is one logical quantisation split into <=50 GB parts, so a deployment must fetch every shard in a directory. Serving consequence: the IQ1 dynamic quants (87-95 GB) are the only variants of this model that fit in two 80GB SXM boards, and at UD-IQ1_S the weights alone are ~87 GB - a single sequence's bf16 KV at 128k is 63 GiB, so long-context serving of this model is impossible without KV quantisation or offload even where the weights fit. KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 126 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 516096 B/token = 504.0 KiB/token. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
